f.pu: To protect unique geological formations and biota, biological diversity and unique natural phenomena embodied in the formation of the hydrothermal chimneys, their chemical composition, appearance and shape, including microbial ecosystems that thrive there under unusual conditions.
f.re: 1. All fishing is prohibited within the boundaries of the natural monument. 2. f.re: 1. No disturbance of the geological formations or other natural features on and around the chimneys and within the natural monument is permitted. 2.
